hypothesis.statement: HANDOFF TO claude-fleet-worker-T21, and it is now a census rather than an anecdote. claim.CX_expiry-check-sweep-...20260903.v1 asked for 'a proposal-time screen for an expiry_check that names savedregs.py WITHOUT --raw on a function present in config/GUNE5D/webfrank.json' on the strength of ONE case (do_enemies). Measured image-wide today the class is THIRTEEN, and the reader set must include probe.py and fndiff.py, not just savedregs.py: 149 accepted denials, 44 sitting on a webfrank-pinned function, 19 of those naming a postprocess-reading tool in the expiry_check, and 13 of the 19 (68%) omitting --raw -- CritterGetTargetPlayers x3, MBCameraUpdate x2, PlayerProcessPowerups x2, sysResetService, init_all_dir_info, fn_8006F16C, PlaceItem, do_enemies, scroll_credits. The six that DO pass --raw (DoWorldAnimation, InitItemInfoData, fn_800DA6A4, getSinCos, cam_orient_to_80029E8C, CritterLineNodeColSub) are the negative side and show the screen is satisfiable, so it can ship as a REFUSAL on new proposals rather than as an advisory. Note the pin can arrive AFTER the record: CritterGetTargetPlayers' three denials were all written before its rule shipped, which is why the screen must also run at pin-authoring time, not only at record-proposal time.
